'''Pendleton''' is a [[Protectron (Fallout 76)|Protectron]] serving as a [[Fallout 76 vendors|vendor]] at [[the Whitespring Resort]] in [[Appalachia]].

==Background==
Pendleton is one of the dozen or so [[Fallout 76 robots and computers|robot]] vendors the Whitespring Resort replaced their [[human]] staff with shortly before the [[Great War]].<ref>[[The Whitespring 2080 Initiative]]</ref> He resides in the Studio 58 store of the Whitespring's mall area. He mainly sells [[Fallout 76 plans|plans]] for [[CAMP|C.A.M.P.]] items related to the Whitespring Resort itself such as statues, benches, and various other kinds of artwork.

'''Marilyn''' is a deceased inhabitant of the [[Foundation Outpost]].

==Background==
Marilyn was a member of the [[Settlers (Wastelanders)|Settlers]] under the leadership of [[Kenneth Dean]] at the outpost. After [[Super mutant (Fallout 76)|super mutants]] attacked and wrecked the outpost, killing its inhabitants,<ref>[[Kenneth's journal]]</ref> Marilyn's corpse can be found by a set of stairs in the settlement.
